scripts.text: - Something mysterious seems to be blocking the way. Let's talk to Chulho first. -
scripts.translation: - 似乎有什麼神秘的東西擋住了去路。先和哲浩談談吧。 -

scripts.text:
[Guard]
You can't pass through here.
Go back.
scripts.translation:
[衛兵]
你過不去了。
回去吧。

scripts.text: Ask them to let you in.

[Guard]
Hyunrok told me not to bring in suspicious people!!
scripts.translation:
[衛兵]
玄律告訴我，不要放可疑的人進來！！

scripts.text:
[Guard]
You can't pass through here.
Go back.
scripts.translation:
[衛兵]
你過不去了。
回去吧。
